us_stores: the GU US product page offers in-store pickup and in-store payment returns. Wikipedia: first permanent global flagship opened in SoHo, Manhattan, 19 September 2024 (after a 2022–2024 pop-up). Fast Retailing's outlet page gives GU only as a worldwide total (481).

known_for: Wikipedia says GU began as 'a more affordable concept in fashion than Uniqlo'; the US homepage banner reads 'Low prices starting at $5.90'. Wikipedia: founded 1973 (company), HQ Minato, Tokyo; wholly owned by Fast Retailing, Uniqlo's parent.
